method.notes: Sources identical, production builds, one server at a time, cyclic engine order, new server each run. Before uses saved pre-optimization native binary AND preserved async-concurrency built runtime. Next preserved audit build. CPU and RSS sum server descendants, load client excluded but shares host. RSS shared pages may be counted twice; client can limit fast routes. Three short trials per route/capacity; sustained one trial. Bounded overload remains intentional beyond 272 in-flight requests per worker.
